name: Potato
siboNotes: Regular potatoes (white, red, russet) are FODMAP-free and safe for SIBO patients. They're an excellent source of safe carbohydrates. Do not confuse with sweet potatoes, which require portion control.
preparationTips: Baking or roasting are simple preparation methods
Avoid adding high-FODMAP toppings (sour cream, chives in large amounts)
Mashed potatoes with lactose-free butter are safe
Cooled potatoes contain resistant starch for gut health
